full_prompt_en: A square, softly modeled oil portrait shows a young girl in a pale wrapped headscarf resting her cheek on one hand against a nearly black background. The dark ground is quiet and unbroken, allowing the illuminated head and upper body to stand forward without a detailed setting. A broad cream cloth wraps around the top of her head in thick overlapping folds. Short light-brown curls appear below its edge and frame the forehead and temples. Her face is near the center, turned gently toward the viewer, with large warm brown eyes, finely arched brows, a small straight nose, and softly closed pink lips. One hand rises from the lower-right portion of the face to support the cheek, its fingers bending under the ear. The pose gives the head a slight tilt and keeps the expression calm and reflective. At the lower edge, a white sleeve with delicate folds emerges beneath a dark green garment, while a narrow patterned warm red-brown fabric appears near the neck. These fabrics are described with careful transitions of light and shadow rather than hard graphic divisions. The skin moves from ivory highlight through muted peach and rose into warm gray shadows, with subtle painterly blending around the eyes and jaw. Light comes from the upper left and front, catching the scarf, forehead, nose, hand, and sleeve, while the far side of the hair dissolves into the dark background. A faint canvas-like texture is visible in the quiet areas, but the face remains the most smoothly finished region. The overall composition is intimate and restrained, balancing pale layered cloth and luminous skin against deep green and black shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、柔和塑形的油画肖像描绘一位戴浅色包头巾的少女单手托腮，背景近乎黑色。深暗底面安静而连续，让受光的头部和上身在没有细描环境的情况下向前浮现。宽大的奶油色布料以厚厚的层叠褶皱裹住头顶。浅棕色短卷发从布边露出，围绕前额和太阳穴。面部靠近中央，轻轻转向观者，有一双暖棕色大眼睛、细弯眉、小而直的鼻子以及柔和闭合的粉色嘴唇。一只手从脸的右下方抬起托住面颊，手指在耳下弯曲。这个姿态让头略微倾斜，神情平静而沉思。沿下缘，一只带柔细褶皱的白色衣袖从深绿色衣服下露出，颈边还有一道带纹样的暖红褐色布料。这些衣料由仔细的光影过渡描绘，而非坚硬的图形切分。皮肤从象牙白亮部经暗桃色和玫瑰色移向暖灰色阴影，眼周与下颌附近有微妙的绘画式融合。光从左上方和正面照来，擦亮头巾、前额、鼻子、手和衣袖，远侧头发则溶入暗色背景。安静区域可见淡淡的画布般肌理，脸部仍是收拾得最平滑的地方。整体构图亲近而克制，以浅色层叠布料和发亮的皮肤平衡深绿色与黑色阴影。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting relies on smooth tonal modeling, selective softness, and a deep unbroken ground. Ivory, muted peach, rose, warm brown, dark green, and near-black form a restrained palette, with the palest planes placed close together as the focal area. Layered folds and curls receive more visible brush texture, while the central light surfaces are blended to a luminous finish. Edges stay precise around expression-bearing details, then soften where dark forms meet the background. Gentle light from above and one side rounds the forms and lets warm shadows taper gradually into black. A close crop and quiet negative space keep the arrangement intimate without decorative clutter. The overall effect is tender and contemplative, with classical painterly volume and carefully controlled contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 油画依靠平滑的明暗塑形、有选择的柔度和深暗连续的底面。象牙白、暗桃色、玫瑰色、暖棕、深绿和近黑色组成克制配色，最浅的几个色面靠拢成为焦点区域。层叠褶皱和卷曲形状保留更多可见笔触，中央受光表面则融合得发亮。边缘在承载表情的细节处准确，深色形体与背景相接处逐渐柔化。上方一侧的柔光使体积圆润，暖影缓缓收进黑色。近距离裁切和安静留白让画面亲密而不杂乱。整体效果温柔而沉思，以古典绘画体积和精心控制的对比建立视觉性格。

name: Hugues Merle
